scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; npm run dev --workspace core-web & npm run dev --workspace manage-web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace core-web && npm run build --workspace manage-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace core-web && npm run lint --workspace manage-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace core-web && npm run typecheck --workspace manage-web
